events.title: DEMO OFFLINE
events.summary: A big thank you to everyone who played the UCCR2 Demo 2.0. I’m taking it offline for now to polish it and bring it up to the standard of the game's Version 1.0 and final release. I’ll be preparing a build for Demo Version 3.0 in time for the October Next Fest which kicks off just before the game's official launch on November 12th. Thanks again for the feedback and for getting a taste of what’s to come see you in November!!!ːsteamhappyː
